latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "extract-structured-data-from-document" (结构化字段抽取工具).

- Provides structured field extraction from documents (PDF, Word, Excel, images) based on user-defined schema.
- Supports extraction of text fields, tables, and paragraphs with precise semantic descriptions.
- Requires schema construction before invocation if not explicitly provided.
- Returns results with value, type, page number, and source coordinates for traceability.
- Handles asynchronous extraction tasks, supporting both automatic result polling and manual result queries.
- Includes detailed usage instructions, input schema format, and multiple practical examples.
